# Project tools skill

Run repository tasks with `pixi run tools`.

This file has two halves. The authoring contract below explains how to add a
task, and the catalog after it lists every task the current graph discovers.
Both render from the live task graph, so the catalog cannot drift from reality.

Regenerate with `pixi run tools skill --write`. CI runs `skill --check` and fails
when the file no longer matches what the graph produces.

## Adding a task

One file registers one task: `tools/<group>/<task>.py`. The directory names the
CLI group, so `tools/rust/lint.py` becomes `rust lint`.

```python
"""Short module summary."""

from __future__ import annotations

from tasknest import ToolContext, tool


@tool(marks=("fast", "ci"), description="Short line shown by `tools ls`.")
def example(ctx: ToolContext, strict: bool = True) -> None:
    """Explain what the task runs."""
    argv = ["alint", "check"]
    if strict:
        argv.append("--strict")
    ctx.run(argv, cwd=ctx.repo_root)
```

Three rules hold for every task:

- **Marks come from `[marks]` in `tasknest.toml`.** An unrecognized mark fails
  the build rather than degrading to a warning, because `checks.unknown_marks`
  is set to `error`.
- **Shared helpers belong in `tools/_lib/`.** Tasknest does not discover that
  directory, and neither does `CC804`.
- **Automation lives here, not in `pixi.toml` or root `package.json`.** Policy
  rejects both, so a task is the only supported entry point.

Project-wide invariants belong in `AGENTS.md`. The human contributor workflow
belongs in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. This file covers the task surface only and does
not restate either.

## Tasks

### `pixi run tools run bindings build` (`bindings.build`)
Build bindings (`all`, `py`, `wasm`, `napi`, `ts`, `ffi`, `kotlin|swift|ruby`).
- Marks: rust, python, ts, ffi, writes
- Options: --target &lt;&#39;all&#39;|&#39;py&#39;|&#39;wasm&#39;|&#39;napi&#39;|&#39;ts&#39;|&#39;ffi&#39;|&#39;kotlin&#39;|&#39;swift&#39;|&#39;ruby&#39;&gt;

### `pixi run tools run bindings stage_napi` (`bindings.stage_napi`)
Stage the per-platform npm package for one napi target (`--suffix`).
- Marks: rust, ts, writes
- Options: --suffix &lt;str&gt;
